# SoundIn

> SoundIn Limited is a Scottish Highlands technology company, solo-founded and operated by Cougar Macdougall, building Holocron — software for the people who work a night out.

SoundIn is registered in Scotland (SC850719) and operates from the Scottish Highlands. It is a one-person company: Cougar Macdougall builds, runs, and supports the product directly.

## Product

### Holocron

Holocron is one shared record for a night out. It handles the operational layer of running a night: attendance tracking, incident logs, guest lists, ticketing, and booking/settlement pipelines between artists, promoters, security, and venues.

Holocron is currently People-first: it is free for artists, promoters, and security. It is in active use with a small, personally-invited trial group of DJs, promoters, and security in Scotland — not a public launch, not open signup, and not currently fundraising. Venue-side onboarding is paused for now while the trial group grows deliberately; the venue side of the product still exists but is not the current priority.

It is built on Next.js, React, and Supabase, and is hosted at holocron.scot.

Holocron is the only active SoundIn product. SoundIn does not currently operate any agency or services business — no event production, social media management, or web development services are offered.

## Who We Work With

DJs, promoters, security, artists, and crew working nightlife in Scotland — currently a small, personally-invited trial group. Venue operators are welcome to get in touch, but SoundIn is not onboarding venues at this time.
